faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.g1q: What is Travel Agency Website & Software Solution?
items.g1a: It is a complete travel agency management platform. It helps you manage leads, create quotations, confirm bookings, generate invoices, track payments, handle vendors, and run reports — all in one place. It's built specifically for travel agencies and tour operators.
items.g2q: Who is this platform designed for?
items.g2a: It's designed for travel agencies, tour operators, Hajj/Umrah service providers, and any business that handles travel bookings. Whether you're a single-person agency or a team of 50+, the platform scales with your needs.
items.g3q: Can I use this for Hajj and Umrah services?
items.g3a: Yes. We have a dedicated Hajj/Umrah module that handles pilgrim registration, package creation with hotel class and transport, room allocation, family grouping, mahram tracking, installment plans, and departure management.
items.g4q: Do I need any technical knowledge to use this?
items.g4a: No. Our platform is designed for travel professionals, not developers. The interface is straightforward — if you can use Facebook or WhatsApp, you can use our platform.
items.p1a: Four plans: Basic (৳500/mo, 500 clients & bookings), Pro (৳800/mo, 1,000 clients & bookings + website + SMS/Email), Business (৳1,500/mo, 2,000 clients & bookings + advanced features), and Unlimited (custom pricing, all features + full automation).
items.p2q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
items.p2a: Absolutely. You can upgrade at any time and the change takes effect immediately. Downgrading is also possible at the end of your billing cycle. Your data is always preserved.
items.p3q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.p3a: We accept bank transfer, bKash, and SSLCommerz for subscription payments. For Unlimited plans, we can arrange custom billing.
items.f1q: Can I create and send quotations to clients?
items.f1a: Yes. The quotation builder lets you add multiple items with pricing, apply discounts, and generate professional PDF quotations. You can track their status (Draft, Sent, Approved, Rejected, Expired) and convert approved quotes directly into bookings.
items.f2q: How does the booking management work?
items.f2a: Bookings support multiple types: tours, flights, hotels, visas, and transport. Each booking can have travelers with passport details, vendor assignments, document uploads, an operations checklist, and a full event timeline. You can also track payment status per booking.
items.f3q: Can I manage vendor costs and track profitability?
items.f3a: Yes. You can assign vendor costs to bookings, track vendor bills (Unpaid, Partial, Paid, Overdue), and see booking-level profitability showing selling price minus vendor cost for gross profit margins.
items.f4a: Reports include: sales analytics, lead-to-booking conversion, payment collection vs outstanding, vendor payable summaries, staff performance comparisons, and booking-level profitability. All reports support date range filters and CSV export.
items.f5q: Can I control what my team members can access?
items.f5a: Yes. Role-based access control lets you define permissions per module (create, edit, delete, approve, export). Built-in roles include Owner, Manager, Accountant, Sales Agent, and Operations staff. You can also create custom roles.
items.s1a: Yes. Each agency gets a completely isolated workspace. Your data is never shared with other agencies. We use encrypted connections, secure authentication, and regular backups.
items.s2a: Yes. Most reports and tables support CSV export. You can also export client lists, booking data, and financial records at any time.
items.s3a: Your data is stored on secure servers. We follow industry-standard practices for data protection and privacy. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
items.sup1a: Free plan users get community support. Basic and Pro plans include email support with 24-hour response times. Business and Enterprise plans get priority support with faster response and dedicated contacts.
items.sup2a: Yes. All paid plans include basic onboarding guidance. Enterprise plans get a dedicated onboarding manager who helps with data migration, team training, and custom setup.
items.sup3q: Can I request a new feature?
items.sup3a: Absolutely. We actively listen to our users. You can submit feature requests through our support channel. Many current features were built based on travel agency feedback.

p: Travel Agency Website & Software Solution ("we", "our", "us") is a multi-tenant travel agency management platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.
**Account Information:** When you register, we collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, and password.
**Business Data:** Client records, booking details, invoices, payment records, vendor information, and other operational data you enter into the platform.

**Traveler Information:** Passport details, travel documents, and personal information of travelers managed through your agency. This data is stored on behalf of your agency and is your responsibility to collect with proper consent.
**Usage Data:** We automatically collect information about how you interact with the platform, including pages visited, features used, and session duration.
**Payment Information:** Subscription payment details such as transaction IDs and payment method. We do not store full credit card numbers.
We use collected information to:
list: Send transactional notifications (booking confirmations, payment receipts)
Improve platform features and user experience
Ensure platform security and prevent fraud

p: Each agency on our platform operates in a completely isolated workspace. Your business data (clients, bookings, invoices, vendor information) is never accessible to other agencies or tenants on the platform. Super-admin access is limited to platform management and does not include access to your operational data content.
We do not sell your data. We may share information with:
list: **Payment Processors:** SSLCommerz, bKash, or other payment gateways to process subscription payments
**SMS/Email Providers:** To deliver notifications you configure
**Legal Requirements:** When required by law or to protect our rights

p: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure authentication with hashed passwords, regular backups, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

We retain your data as long as your account is active. If you cancel your subscription, your data will be retained for 90 days before permanent deletion. You can request earlier deletion by contacting support.

You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. You can export most data through the platform's built-in export features. For account deletion or data requests, contact us at support@travelagencyweb.com.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify registered users of significant changes via email. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
By accessing or using Travel Agency Website & Software Solution ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.

The Platform is a multi-tenant software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for travel agency management. It provides tools for lead management, quotation building, booking operations, invoicing, payment tracking, vendor management, team collaboration, and reporting.

To use the Platform, you must register an account with accurate information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Each agency operates as a separate tenant with isolated data.

The Platform offers multiple subscription plans with varying features and limits. You will be billed according to your selected plan and billing cycle (monthly or yearly). Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) unless otherwise stated.

You may upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. Refunds are not provided for partial billing periods unless required by law.
You agree not to:
list: Use the Platform for any unlawful purpose
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other tenants' data
Interfere with or disrupt the Platform's infrastructure
Upload malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
Resell access to the Platform without written consent
Use the Platform to store or transmit content that violates any applicable law

p: You retain ownership of all data you enter into the Platform, including client records, booking details, financial data, and documents. We do not claim ownership of your business data. You grant us a limited license to process and store this data solely for the purpose of providing the service.

We strive to maintain 99.9% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Scheduled maintenance will be communicated in advance when possible. We are not liable for any losses resulting from temporary service unavailability.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Platform shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, business opportunities, or goodwill, arising from your use of the Platform.

Either party may terminate the agreement at any time. You can cancel your subscription from your account settings. We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. Upon termination, your data will be retained for 90 days before permanent deletion.

We may modify these Terms of Service at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email to registered users. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Bangladesh. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be resolved in the courts of Dhaka, Bangladesh.

workflow.title: The core workflow
workflow.subtitle: Every agency runs on the same money trail. Follow it and nothing slips.

phases.title: Capture the customer
steps: Someone asks for a price — add them as a client (or as a quick inquiry booking).
Record what they want: destination, dates, number of travellers.
Send a quotation if they need a formal price.

phases.title: Confirm the sale
steps: When they agree, create (or convert the quotation into) a booking.
Set the booking status to Confirmed.
Assign a staff member or agent so it's clear who owns it.

phases.title: Collect the money
steps: Raise the invoice from the booking — totals are filled in for you.
Record each payment (cash, bKash, bank, card). The balance updates automatically.
Overdue and partly-paid invoices show up on the Dashboard and Invoices page.

phases.title: Track profit & operations
steps: Log supplier costs and office expenses so profit is real, not a guess.
Use Reports to see revenue, dues and profit for any date range.
Complete the trip, then keep the client for repeat business.

threePillars.title: Three areas, one system
threePillars.subtitle: Understanding these three keeps the menu simple.

items.title: Catalog — what you sell
items.desc: Packages and services you offer. Reusable templates for quotes and bookings.

items.title: Sales & operations — the deal
items.desc: Quotations and bookings for a specific customer. This is where the work happens.

items.title: Money — cash in and out
items.desc: Invoices, payments, expenses and the ledger. The heart of the system.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.intro: Set up your agency once, then you're ready to work. This takes about five minutes.
steps: Log in with the email and password you were given. The interface opens in English — switch to Bangla any time from the language button in the top bar.
Open Settings → Organization and enter your agency name, logo, phone, address and website.
Review your plan under Subscription so you know your limits and which modules you have.
Add your team under Team so each person logs in with their own account and role.
Add a client and a service, then create your first booking to see the flow end to end.
tips: Practise on the demo account first — you can't break anything there.
The onboarding checklist on the Dashboard walks you through the same steps.

daily-workflow.title: Your daily routine
daily-workflow.intro: Open one screen a day and you'll never lose a customer or a payment.
steps: Open the Dashboard — it shows today's follow-ups, dues, and new inquiries.
Work the follow-up list: message or call each customer, then snooze or convert.
Record any payments that came in — the balances update everywhere instantly.
Add new inquiries as they arrive (name, phone, what they want — 10 seconds).
Before closing, check overdue invoices and send a reminder where needed.
tips: If you only do one thing a day, clear the Dashboard follow-up list.

language.title: Language — English & Bangla
language.intro: The whole system works in both English and Bangla. English is the default; Bangla is one tap away.
steps: Find the language button in the top bar (it shows the other language you can switch to).
Tap it to switch the entire interface between English and Bangla instantly.
Your choice is remembered on this device for next time.
tips: Each staff member can choose their own language — it doesn't change it for anyone else.

sidebar-map.title: The menu, explained
sidebar-map.intro: The left menu is grouped so you always know where to look.
steps: Overview — your Dashboard and daily snapshot.
Contacts — Clients and Vendors/Suppliers.
Sales & bookings — Quotations, Bookings and your service catalog.
Money — Invoices, Payments, Expenses, Accounts and Reports.
Manage — Tasks, Team, Settings, Organization and Subscription.
Advanced modules (Hajj desk, website, HR, sub-agents and more) appear only on Business and Ultimate plans, once switched on in Settings → Optional modules.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your agency at a glance — the numbers that matter and the tasks that need you today.
steps: Top cards show revenue, dues, bookings and profit for the current period.
The follow-up strip lists inquiries due today so nothing is forgotten.
Click any card or row to jump straight to the underlying list.

inquiry-followup.title: Inquiries & follow-ups
inquiry-followup.intro: A customer who only asked a price is your most valuable lead. Capture it in seconds.
steps: When someone asks for a price, add a booking and set its status to Inquiry.
It appears on the Dashboard under 'inquiries to follow up'.
Not ready to buy? Snooze it to a date and it comes back on that day.
Ready? Message or call them straight from the row.
When they agree, change the status to Confirmed — invoice and payment follow automatically.
tips: There's no separate lead module — the booking status handles the whole journey.
Set a follow-up date on every inquiry so it never falls through the cracks.

clients.title: Clients
clients.intro: Your customer database — the asset that drives repeat business.
steps: Add a client with name and phone; email, passport, NID and address are optional.
Upload passport and document scans to the client's profile for quick access.
Set passport expiry so you get alerts before it lapses.
Mark corporate clients as a company to track their staff travel together.
Open any client to see their full history: bookings, invoices and payments.
tips: Tag your best customers as VIP or Repeat to find them fast.
A complete client profile makes the next booking twice as quick.

vendors.title: Vendors & suppliers
vendors.intro: Airlines, hotels, transport and visa partners — and what you owe them.
steps: Add each supplier with a category (airline, hotel, transport, visa).
Record supplier bills against a booking to track your costs.
Log payments to suppliers so payables stay accurate.
tips: The payables view shows who you owe and when it's due.

corporate.title: Corporate travel
corporate.intro: Manage company clients whose staff travel regularly. (Business & Ultimate plans.)
steps: Add the company as a corporate client.
Book travel for their employees and group it under the company.
Use the corporate view to see each company's spend and open invoices.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.intro: A professional price quote the customer can say yes to.
steps: Create a quotation from a client or an inquiry.
Add line items (flights, hotel, transport) with your selling price.
Start from a package to fill the details automatically.
Send it to the customer; track whether it's sent, accepted or rejected.
When accepted, convert it to a booking in one click — nothing is retyped.

packages.title: Packages & services
packages.intro: Reusable templates for what you sell — so quotes and bookings are fast.
steps: Create a package with a title, code and price.
Set the service type (Umrah, tour, air ticket, visa, and more).
Add inclusions, itinerary and pricing so it's ready to reuse.
Mark your best sellers as featured.
Reuse a package in any quotation or booking to save typing.
tips: Keep a few well-built packages — they speed up every sale.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: The confirmed deal — the centre of your operations.
steps: Create a booking directly, or convert it from a quotation.
Pick the type (package, ticket, hotel, visa, tour) and the client.
Enter the selling amount and your cost — profit is calculated for you.
Set the status: Inquiry, Confirmed, Completed or Cancelled.
Assign a staff member or agent so ownership is clear.
Raise the invoice straight from the booking.
tips: Use Inquiry status for price-askers so they land on your Dashboard.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Bill the customer and always know exactly what's owed.
steps: Generate the invoice from a booking — totals are filled in for you.
Send it to the customer; the status tracks paid, partial, unpaid and overdue.
Record payments against it and the balance updates automatically.
The Invoices page and Dashboard highlight anything overdue.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Record money as it comes in so dues are always accurate.
steps: Open an invoice and add a payment (cash, bKash, bank transfer, card).
The invoice balance and the client's dues update instantly.
Partial payments are supported — take an advance now, the rest later.
Each payment posts to your ledger automatically.
tips: Installments are ideal for Hajj and big tour packages — record each one as it arrives.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.intro: Log what your agency spends so profit is real, not a guess.
steps: Add an expense with a category (rent, salary, marketing, utilities).
Set the amount, date and how it was paid.
Expenses flow into your accounts and profit reports.

accounts.title: Accounts & ledger
accounts.intro: The full financial picture — cash, bank, receivables and payables.
steps: Set up your cash, bank and mobile (bKash) accounts.
Every payment and expense posts to the ledger automatically.
See receivables (what customers owe) and payables (what you owe suppliers).
Check profitability per booking and overall.
Filter the ledger by date to reconcile a period.
Export to CSV for your accountant.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Understand your business with numbers, not guesswork.
steps: Pick a date range to focus any report.
Sales report — revenue and bookings over time.
Profitability — selling price minus cost, per booking and overall.
Payments — what came in, by method.
Receivables — outstanding dues by customer.
Staff and agent performance — who's driving revenue.
Export any report for records or sharing.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: Simple to-dos so operational steps never get missed.
steps: Add a task with a title, due date and priority.
Assign it to a team member.
Mark it done when complete — overdue tasks stay visible.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Keep passports, tickets and vouchers in one safe place.
steps: Upload documents to a client, booking or the central library.
Find a file fast by client or booking.
Download or share when you need it.

team.title: Team & roles
team.intro: Add your staff and control who can see and do what.
steps: Invite a team member by email from the Team page.
Choose a role: Owner, Manager, Sales agent, Accountant or Operations.
Each role sees only the parts of the system it needs.
Deactivate anyone who leaves so their access ends immediately.
tips: Keep finance (Accountant) separate from booking approval — it protects your cash.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Your agency's identity across the whole system.
steps: Set your name, logo, phone, address and website.
These details appear on invoices, quotations and your public site.
Keep them current — customers see them everywhere.

subscription.title: Subscription & plan
subscription.intro: Your plan sets your limits and which modules you can use.
steps: See your current plan, price and renewal date.
Compare plans to know what each unlocks.
Upgrade to Business or Ultimate to switch on advanced modules.
Submit a payment request to renew; the admin approves it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Configure the system to match how your agency works.
steps: Organization, billing, notifications and optional modules live here.
Business & Ultimate: switch advanced modules on or off under Optional modules.
Set notification preferences for new bookings, payments and inquiries.

agents.title: Sub-agents & commission
agents.intro: Work with B2B sub-agents and track their commission. (Business & Ultimate plans.)
steps: Add each agent and set their commission rate.
Assign bookings to an agent to attribute the sale.
See each agent's bookings, sales and commission owed.

operations.title: Service operations desk
operations.intro: Operational tracking for visa, ticketing and service files. (Business & Ultimate plans.)
steps: Track the operational status of each service file separately from payment.
Move files through their steps to completion.
See what's pending action across all bookings.

hajj.title: Hajj & Umrah operations
hajj.intro: A dedicated desk for pilgrims, groups and installments. (Business & Ultimate plans.)
steps: Create Hajj/Umrah packages and groups.
Add pilgrims with passport, mahram and rooming details.
Track each pilgrim's installment payments and balance.
Manage visa and document status per pilgrim.
tips: Installment tracking is built for the way Hajj is paid in Bangladesh.

website.title: Website & CMS
website.intro: Build a public website for your agency. (Business & Ultimate plans.)
steps: Choose a template and set your colours, logo and content.
Publish your packages so customers can browse them online.
Add a blog and set SEO details to be found on Google.
Connect your own domain and go live.

notifications.title: Notifications — SMS, email & WhatsApp
notifications.intro: Keep customers informed automatically. (SMS/WhatsApp on higher plans.)
steps: The bell shows in-app alerts for bookings, payments and inquiries.
Set up SMS and WhatsApp under Settings to send confirmations and reminders automatically.

portal.title: Customer & supplier portal
portal.intro: A self-service login for your customers and suppliers.
steps: Customers sign in with a magic link (no password to remember).
They see their bookings, invoices and payment status.
Suppliers can review the bills you've shared with them.
tips: The portal is separate from your staff login and shows only that person's records.

workflow.title: Super admin process (step by step)
workflow.subtitle: Follow this flow for every new agency signup and subscription payment.
steps: New agency registers → 7-day Pro trial starts automatically (no manual approval needed).
Check Admin → Payment Requests when agency submits bKash/Nagad/bank payment.
Verify transaction ID + amount → Approve → choose plan, billing cycle, Activate now.
Agency refreshes or logs in again → full portal access restored until next expiry.
Before expiry: cron sends reminders. After expiry: agency can log in but sees payment screen only.
To suspend an agency: Subscriptions or Agency detail → Suspend (blocks access immediately).
Configure receiving numbers: Payment Requests → save bKash/Nagad/Rocket/bank details.
Custom domains: Domains → verify DNS → activate SSL for Pro+ agencies.
